pt: Duelo ao vivo: desafie um amigo e vença quem fizer mais pontos em 60 segundos
Capture as bolas mantendo o ritmo e jogue LENTO, RELÓGIO ou STOP no rival
Convites na hora, com revanche e placar do rival durante a partida
en: Live duels: challenge a friend, most points in 60 seconds wins
Catch the orbs by keeping up the pace and throw SLOW, CLOCK or STOP at your rival
Instant challenges, rematches and your rival's score as you play
